function.name: DEFINE_REGION
function.param: Horizontal coordinate of top left corner
Vertical coordinate of top left corner
Width in pixels of the region
Height in pixels of the region
function.abstract: It allows to define a region

description.p: This function allows to define the limits of a region. There are 32 avaliable regions, but you must know that the region 0 is always to full screen and it can not be changed.

A region is a zone of screen of special interest. The regions are specially useful in games in which the visible zone does not corresponds to the game area: for example, a zone can be destinied to use of marks. The regions can be used to:
Define the occuped area for a scroll region.
Define an area of "clipping", where the processes that are marked like beloging to the same will be cutted of for their limits.
Define a zone of screen where we wanna know easily when a process is in or out.

This function allows to establish the limits of a region. The coordinates are always in pixels, where (0, 0) corresponds to top left corner of screen. However, define a region has not any effect until it is used. You can assign the number of region to the variable of a process, use with , or use the function with the new region defined.
